entries.tactical_failure_mode_quoted: The recurring failure is assembling a decompose-and-delegate pipeline whose components are all off-the-shelf — role-agents, prompts, existing engines, retrieval modules — so that no single piece is shown to be both novel and load-bearing. The intermediate artifact stays advisory (read by the next stage but never closed by a verification signal), reducing the system to sampling-plus-filtering or to a re-skin of an already-published neighbor that performed the same routing move.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: A decomposition that merely chains off-the-shelf agents or engines, with no single component demonstrated to be both novel and load-bearing, reads as engineering assembly rather than a contribution.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: FastWAM, a logistic head, ridge response fitting, and OSQP are off-the-shelf, while the only proposed novel handoff—the full interaction ledger—is not load-bearing because Step 6 collapses it to a center gradient exactly reproducible by an interaction-free central-difference baseline.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: If the 'key' prompt or elicitation scheme is tuned to one benchmark and not validated across settings, reviewers treat it as a dataset-specific hack instead of a transferable mechanism.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Without an ablation isolating the decomposition's marginal effect from extra data, more epochs, or the base model's prior knowledge, the reported gains read as confounded and unattributable.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Re-deriving a routing move that a closely neighboring published system already demonstrated, while showing only marginal gains, fails the novelty bar regardless of engineering polish.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: The closest listed neighbor routes a proposal-conditioned latent future into a neural refiner; neither the literature table nor collision pool shows the same typed marginal–interaction ledger routed to a constrained solver.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: A self-improvement or decomposition loop whose reliability hinges on an unvalidated data-generation, retrieval, or filtering component invites rejection when error propagation across iterations is never analyzed.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: The outcome head is fitted from the simulator's existing success predicate with held-out calibration, and E0 separately checks predicted interaction signs against restored-state executed contrasts.

entries.tactical_failure_mode_quoted: Papers attempting this tactic fail most often when the constructed instrument isolates the confound only inside an artificial regime and never demonstrates that the isolated signal transfers to real deployment conditions — the synthetic-to-real gap is asserted rather than shown. A second recurring shape is circularity: the diagnostic is validated against the same definition, assumption, or system population it was built to interrogate (using the evaluated models as their own oracle, or hardcoding a contested definition of the target property), so it cannot independently confirm what it claims.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: A diagnostic that only re-confirms a shortcut already known in advance, surfacing no previously unmeasurable failure, is read as confirmatory rather than as a contribution.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Validating a synthetic-ground-truth instrument only on synthetic data, without demonstrating that the controlled finding transfers to real-world instances, leaves ecological validity unestablished and undermines the central claim.

entries.tactical_pattern_quoted: Have the learned model emit a structured, machine-checkable intermediate artifact at the decomposition boundary — an executable program, a formal domain/world model, a relational-or-constraint graph, a concrete state waypoint, an interleaved reason-act/tool-call trace, or a typed inter-agent deliverable — in place of a final answer, then route that artifact to a sound solver (interpreter, classical planner, constraint solver, MCTS/RL optimizer) or back through the model's own verify-and-revise loop. The recurring innovation is converting the intermediate representation from advisory output into a load-bearing object that something downstream can mechanically check.
